about.title: The key to your success is in trusted hands
about.intro: IG GROUP is a registered audit firm (SARAS-F-412837) offering companies audit, accounting, tax, consulting and valuation services. Our team includes certified auditors, chief accountants and a lawyer, and the company's professional liability is insured. The company has been operating since 2011.

mission.title: Our mission
paragraphs: Today, as technology and the business environment change at an ever faster pace, a company's success largely depends on managing time well and focusing on what matters most.
That is why you need a financial partner who saves you time and energy and simplifies complex financial tasks.
At IG GROUP every engagement begins with an in-depth study of the client's needs - so that our solution fits your business precisely.

focus.title: Focus on goals
focus.text: We work to achieve your business goals, not merely to meet formal requirements.

trust.title: Reliability
trust.text: Client information is strictly confidential, and our conclusions are independent and objective.

professionalism.title: Professionalism
professionalism.text: We act in full compliance with professional standards and applicable law.

responsibility.title: Strong sense of responsibility
responsibility.text: We stand behind the quality of our work and our deadlines.

adaptability.title: Adaptability
adaptability.text: We constantly follow legislative and technological changes and communicate them to clients in good time.

experience.title: Experience
experience.text: Since 2011 we have helped companies in trade, construction, manufacturing, services, agriculture, logistics and telecommunications manage their financial and tax matters.

team.title: Our team
team.intro: Our team brings together certified auditors, experienced accountants and a lawyer, so your financial, tax and legal matters are handled in one place.

insurance.title: Professional insurance
insurance.text: IG GROUP's professional liability is insured. This is an additional guarantee for clients that our services are delivered with full responsibility.

independence.title: Principle of independence
independence.text: We provide audit services in strict compliance with independence requirements.

servicesPage.title: Financial services in one place
servicesPage.intro: From audit to business valuation: six areas that cover your company's financial, tax and valuation needs.

audit.title: Audit services
audit.short: Independent audit of financial statements in line with international standards.
audit.heading: An independent opinion people trust
audit.intro: A financial statement audit strengthens the trust of investors, banks and partners in your company. We conduct audits in accordance with International Standards on Auditing (ISA).
items: Statutory and voluntary audits of financial statements;
Reviews of financial information;
Agreed-upon procedures;
Recommendations to improve internal control (management letter).

accounting.title: Accounting services
accounting.short: Full bookkeeping and preparation of financial statements.
accounting.heading: Entrust your accounting to professionals
accounting.intro: Accurate and timely accounting is the foundation of sound management. We take care of it so you can focus on your business.
items: Full-cycle bookkeeping;
Preparation and filing of tax returns;
Preparation of financial statements (IFRS / IFRS for SMEs);
Payroll accounting;
Review and restoration of existing records.

tax-risk.title: Tax risk assessment
tax-risk.short: Identifying tax risks early, before they turn into penalties.
tax-risk.heading: A successful business without penalties
tax-risk.note: Recommendations are based on current tax legislation
tax-risk.intro: It is better to identify a tax risk in advance than during a tax audit. We analyse your operations and documentation and propose ways to reduce risk.
items: Diagnostics of tax obligations;
Identification and assessment of weak points;
Recommendations to eliminate risks;
Support in preparing for a tax audit.

consulting.title: Consulting services
consulting.short: Financial and tax advice for important decisions.
consulting.heading: Time to seek financial advice from experts
consulting.intro: An important business decision requires precise financial and tax analysis. We help you make the right choice.
items: Tax consulting;
Financial consulting and analysis;
Advice on starting a new business or restructuring;
Methodological support in preparing financial statements.

property-valuation.title: Property valuation
property-valuation.short: Objective valuation of real estate and movable property.
property-valuation.heading: Objective valuation for the right decision
property-valuation.intro: A well-founded estimate of market value for a bank, a court, a purchase or sale, or accounting purposes.
items: Valuation of real estate (residential, commercial, land);
Valuation of movable property (vehicles, machinery and equipment, inventory);
Preparation of an official valuation report.

business-valuation.title: Business valuation
business-valuation.short: Well-founded valuation of a company or an equity stake.
business-valuation.heading: Know the real value of your business
business-valuation.intro: Valuing a company or a stake is essential when attracting investment, buying or selling a share, reorganising, or in a dispute.
items: Valuation of enterprises and equity stakes;
Valuation of intangible assets;
A valuation report with a justified methodology.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: Through the contact form we receive the information you provide: your name, company name, phone number, email address, selected service and message.

sections.title: Purpose of processing
sections.text: The data is used solely to respond to your request and offer the relevant service. It is not shared with third parties, except for the technical form delivery service.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
